# Writing Beats Co-writing Skill for Muse

Hand Muse a pile of raw material — notes, transcripts, half-formed ideas — and it turns it into a finished article one beat at a time, like a choose-your-own-adventure: it offers you two or three candidate opening beats, you pick the one that lands, and the journey grows from there. Each new beat can only build on concepts the reader has already met, so the article never leans on an idea it hasn't introduced first. Discovered via skills.sh. Beta note: this skill lives in the author's experimental in-progress folder, so treat it as a promising beta. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
